info.title: Avi DebugServiceEngine Object API
info.description:
Avi DebugServiceEngine object api
```
- debug serviceengine <key>
- show debug serviceengine <key>
```

API permission: PERMISSION_SERVICEENGINE

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: object name

parameters.name: refers_to
parameters.description: Filter to request all objects that refers to another Avi resource. Its syntax is refers_to=<obj_type>:<obj_uuid>. Eg. get all virtual services referring to pool p1 will be refers_to=pool:pool_p1_uuid

parameters.name: referred_by
parameters.description: Filter to request all objects that are referred by another Avi resource. Its syntax is referred_by=<obj_type>:<obj_uuid>. Eg. get all pools referred_by virtual service vs1 - referred_by=virtualservice:vs_vs1_uuid

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: List of fields to be returned for the resource. Some fields like name, URL, uuid etc. are always returned.

parameters.name: include_name
parameters.description: All the Avi REST reference URIs have a name suffix as URI#name. It is useful to get the referenced resource name without performing get on that object.

parameters.name: skip_default
parameters.description: Default values are not set.

parameters.name: join_subresources
parameters.description: It automatically returns additional dependent resources like runtime. Eg. join_subresources=runtime.

dis_enable.description: Toggle High CPU Trigger action. Set to true, to dis-enable High CPU Data Collection Script invocation. Field introduced in 31.1.2. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

manual_start.description: Invokes High CPU Data Collection on SE for duration of an hour. Alert  Operator will have to manually dis-enable this and manage SE disk-space!. Field introduced in 31.1.2. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

pids.description: List of process' pid(s) for which debug data should be recorded. Field introduced in 31.1.2. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

process_names.description: List of process' name(s) for which debug data should be recorded. Field introduced in 31.1.2. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

sample_cooldown.description: Interval between each such script invocation. Should be >= 60. Allowed values are 60-864000. Field introduced in 31.1.2. Unit is SEC. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

sample_duration.description: Duration of debug data to be collected. Should be >= 11. Allowed values are 11-864000. Field introduced in 31.1.2. Unit is SEC. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

spike_duration.description: Time Duration ( in seconds ) to be considered for CPU to be consistently under high load. Should be >= 60s. CPU usage data is collected every 5s. Allowed values are 60-864000. Field introduced in 31.1.2. Unit is SEC. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.
